subject: Close trajectory & security checklist — NexusBank MAP
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@nexusbank.com>, procurement@nexusbank.com
Cc: security.team@nexusbank.com
Date: Thu, 20 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close trajectory & security checklist — NexusBank MAP

Alex / NexusBank team,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our latest SOC 2 report so your security and procurement teams can line up acceptance gates. High level ask: please confirm whether the timelines below match your expected close window so we can reserve Dedicated capacity and prioritize the DPA redline review.

Proposed near-term milestones (we can adjust):
- Evidence intake for SOC 2 artifacts: target by 2028-10-06
- Complete DPA redline pass and initial countersign: target by 2028-10-13
- Production pilot (hosted) acceptance criteria run: target by 2028-10-27

Key gating items in this MAP:
- SOC 2: evidence package (control narratives, system description), PoC access window for control verification
- SIG/CAIQ: completed questionnaire + supporting artifacts for high-risk controls
- DPA: data residency and deletion timelines + approved retention carveouts (if any)
- Data retention: default 7-day cache TTL for ephemeral tokens; optional configurable archival to US-only regions

Attachments:
- redwood_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners)
- SOC2-report-2027.pdf (third-party report, for control baseline)
- DPA-redlines-Nexus_2028.docx (initial redline we propose)

Next steps:
- Alex: can your security team call out any additional evidence owners we should include on the MAP?
- Procurement: please confirm PO and procurement cadence so we can align billing start to the pilot date.

If the dates work, I’ll run an internal pre-handoff to make sure Jordan and Marissa are ready to jump on evidence intake and DPA negotiations respectively.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from security and procurement:

- SOC 2: we need clarification on the scope (does the report cover hosted API vs private deployment?). Please indicate which services and regions are in scope.
- SIG/CAIQ: can you provide a completed CAIQ export? Our team uses that to populate our intake tracker.
- DPA: our legal team flagged two items — (1) retention carveouts for customer-provided logs, and (2) a deletion confirmation SLA after contract termination.
- Evidence timing: our security team requested the evidence intake window be at least two full weeks before our acceptance demo so they have time to validate controls.

Timeline constraint: internal finance needs the PO in hand before 2028-10-10 to meet month-end approval. Can you firm up the DPA cadence so procurement can plan?

Forwarding for visibility: security.team@nexusbank.com will attach a short SIG baseline and expected CAIQ fields later today.

Thanks,
Alex Murphy
Head of Cloud Programs, NexusBank
alex.murphy@nexusbank.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Close trajectory & security checklist — NexusBank MAP

Team — forwarding Alex's questions. Quick plan: can Jordan confirm the SOC 2 scope lines (hosted API + analytics service only; private deploys separate annex) and whether the control narratives include region scoping? Marissa — can you take point on DPA redline (items Alex flagged) and prepare a short cover letter explaining our proposed deletion confirmation (standard 30 days, can shorten with additional escrow).

I want to provide NexusBank a single consolidated response with:
- an updated MAP (owners + revised dates to respect two-week evidence intake)
- completed CAIQ export attached
- DPA cover letter + tracked redlines and a DocuSign link for countersign

If we can turn that by EOD Monday (2028-09-24), procurement should be able to meet the 10/10 PO cadence. Mark any items you need legal on.

Thanks,
Kim

Date: Mon, 24 Sep 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close trajectory & security checklist — NexusBank MAP

Alex — thanks for the quick turn. Please see consolidated response and updated MAP below (attached). Summary of changes and asks: 

1) SOC 2 scope
- Confirmed scope: Hosted Redwood API (generation, chat, embeddings) + associated telemetry/analytics pipeline in US regions. Private/VPC and on-prem packages are out-of-scope for this SOC2 report; we will provide an annexed statement if you pursue private deployment.
- Attachment: SOC2-report-2027.pdf (control narratives included). If you need a short call to walk through specific controls, Jordan can host a 30-minute session.

2) SIG/CAIQ
- Attached: completed CAIQ export (see 'redwood_CAICQ_export.csv' inside the MAP workbook). We highlighted items typically flagged by banking customers (key management, separation of duties).

3) DPA redlines and data retention
- Marissa addressed your two flags in DPA-redlines-Nexus_2028.docx. Key proposals:
  - Retention carveouts: accept NexusBank's customer-provided logs as a documented exception; we’ll include an S3 lifecycle rule that isolates those logs and aligns retention to your policy.
  - Deletion confirmation SLA: standard is 30 days; we can offer a 14-day deletion confirmation SLA as a concession in exchange for a standard reservation on escrow/keystore terms.
- For countersign: we’ve created a DocuSign packet for the redlined DPA and a short cover letter explaining the deletion SLA tradeoff: https://app.docusign.com/packets/EXAMPLE-NB-DPA-2028

4) Adjusted MAP milestones (respecting your two-week evidence intake request):
- Evidence intake open window: 2028-10-08 to 2028-10-19
- DPA countersign target: 2028-10-12 (DocuSign send 2028-09-24)
- Pilot acceptance demo: 2028-10-26

Attachments included with this reply:
- redwood_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (updated tabs: MAP_v2, CAIQ_export)
- SOC2-report-2027.pdf
- DPA-redlines-Nexus_2028.docx (tracked changes)

Action items for NexusBank:
- Confirm the evidence owners in the MAP (names + emails) by 2028-09-27 so we can open evidence intake on 10/08.
- Procurement: confirm PO timing; we'll align billing start to the pilot commencement.

If you’re good with the approach, Jordan will host a 45-minute SOC walkthrough on 2028-10-02 (proposed). Marissa will be available for a legal Q&A 2028-09-26.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
